description.value: Botanist is the flagship fine-dining restaurant of the Fairmont Pacific Rim hotel, set in Vancouver's waterfront Coal Harbour district with both an indoor dining room and an outdoor garden terrace. Executive Chef Hector Laguna leads a menu rooted in Pacific Northwest ingredients — sustainably sourced seafood, organic produce from local farmers, and regionally inspired seasonal dishes. The venue also houses an inventive cocktail bar and lab with a terroir-driven wine program focused on small-batch, biodynamic producers.
